name: voice-reply
description: Claude Code desktop (macOS) mod: when a turn finishes in the session you are looking at, speak a short spoken-style summary of the answer aloud (edge-tts, falls back to macOS say). One 🔊 button above the prompt toggles it for all sessions.

voice.title: Voice / 声音
voice.description: Default voice (the 🔊 band dropdown overrides it): Xiaoxiao 晓晓 (female, warm), Xiaoyi 晓伊 (female, lively), HsiaoChen 晓臻 (female, Taiwan accent), Yunxi 云希 (male, bright), Yunyang 云扬 (male, calm).

fallbackVoice.title: Offline voice / 离线声音
fallbackVoice.description: macOS say voice used when edge-tts is unavailable or offline (run `say -v '?'` to list).

summaryModel.title: Summary model / 摘要模型
summaryModel.description: Model alias used to rewrite the answer into a short spoken summary.

minChars.title: Min answer length / 最短朗读长度
minChars.description: Answers shorter than this (characters) are spoken as they are, without summarizing.
